items.note: The bit case matches the paper: triples of [100], the eight-row schedule, net change (JV+RG)x independent of the scratch values, central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 with side cancellation, and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The plan states the lemma only for the bit network, though. The complex construction (even-intersection neighbours, the C_* wire, the coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, lines 695-703 and 756-758) never appears, even though S2.1 relies on it.

S1.3.2 states the frame invariant, the common gate frame, edge operators D_v D_u^{-1}, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, all as in the paper. It is an infer step that carries the reason only in its quote, with no method or sub-steps, so it counts as stated.

The plan follows the paper step by step. It has the form I-J/9 with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the gate order and its side and central labels, the residual table with the side edge 2->5 using t_X perp t_Y, the single loss of h on centre 3->4, L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L, L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539, and orthonormal residual bases over F_2. Only the binary label field (F_2^h with the dot product) is left implicit.

The plan matches the paper's proof: the assignment P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources and 0 elsewhere; rank of P_V-P_U equal to dim V - dim U; the N first edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one; s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0; and the endpoint difference I_m on every role. S1.3.5 then turns this into the shear H<-H+D through the frames Phi_M.

The plan matches the paper's proof: phase frames with q_U=wt(P_U x) mod 4, weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight of each basis vector giving aI+bX_v or its inverse after Hadamard conjugation, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with no source term, and the correction of the 27 inverted coordinates by Z and i^{27k}, giving C^{otimes mk} on every role.

The bit side is complete and correct: eta_b=339/22587335000000 > 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-20*2^{-50}) > m(1-eta_b) = s_b/W_b. The complex deficit eta_c=73/19906842167500 never appears, and s_c/W_c <= m^sigma is only asserted in S2.8, not derived.
S1.1 and S1.2 restate the two lemmas with their O(V) bounds and the b^{O(1)} offset condition. S1.2 gives a one-line mechanism that fits only the shift; see errors.

The plan follows the paper: A=E_1 Pi E_2 by elimination with the topmost row and its rightmost pivot, a prime q avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators, triangular updates in descending physical order, and each one of Pi done as D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j. That gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V).

The plan follows the paper: a cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W; Phi_{A_e} on every edge, giving Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D, on every row including scratch rows; the interchange D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D; s calls, so F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau); and the parking-stack schedule costing O(V) per node.

The plan follows the paper: high digits rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) as a row field of range q^{2 rho}>=W^k padded to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces with a_j<m and m^k<me, then padding [2^u] to [q^e] with e=O(u). The unequal-width variant (1740-1762) is omitted, but it is not needed for the main route.

The plan covers each step of the paper's construction: P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with the residual basis as the first columns of M, e=mf split into m slots of f chunks, exactly s_c forward children via (C^{-1})^{otimes f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D.

The plan follows the paper's proof: the eight +-1 steps inducing (00 01 10) then (01 10 11); each line as one cyclic shift whose offset does not depend on its target; the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11; delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} by the union bound; repair because T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes B; the top bit done separately; and the cost bound. The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the rows from the first q_0=O(log d) chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e) below d^beta, the internal sum O(e^lambda) and the leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) all match. The plan omits the base-m decomposition of D-q_0 into pieces and the log(2d) factor that lambda' absorbs (2432-2445), which is how the per-group bound becomes O(Vd^{lambda'}).

The statement (H_0 on one selected bit per chunk, one final Q_p, cost O(Vd^{lambda'}), error < sqrt2 2^{-p}) and the final disk argument match the paper. The guard-width bound Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) is only asserted. The plan never gives the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the constants E, B, nu, or the induction from depth to denominator and magnitude (2479-2573).

errors.says: Both the controlled update y -> y+a(controls) mod q^b and multiplication of y by a fixed rational unit cost O(V) 'by splitting every fiber of q^b blocks at the offset and merging the two pieces in swapped order'.
errors.paper: The two-piece split at Q-a implements only the cyclic shift (574-580). Multiplication by an integer c prime to q splits each fiber into c increasing pieces classified by floor(cy/Q) and merges them with a residue counter. Inverse multiplication reverses that split and merge, and negation is done by a reversing stack (592-614).

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. Interchange comes from the bit network (S1), the butterfly layer from the complex network (S2), and those feed the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), the resampling, chirp and CRT assembly with exact recovery (S4), and the cost table (S5); the rank-saving recursion is reconstructed in full on the bit side. It thins out on the complex side: the complex scalar network is never described, eta_c and s_c/W_c < m^sigma are asserted rather than derived, the layer's guard-width depth recurrence is only asserted, and the base-m piece sum that yields O(Vd^{lambda'}) is skipped.

steps.note: S1.3.1 gives banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3 with triples of [100], and three stages sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire. S1.3.3.6 gives N=v^3 with v=C(100,3). m=h^3 is left implicit as the dimension of (Q^h)^{otimes 3}.

S1.3.2 has a common invertible frame per gate, D_v D_u^{-1} on edges, the result D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator fixed by the endpoint frames whatever the intermediate frames. The commuting with the pointwise gate is quoted.

The labels are nondegenerate subspaces of (Q^h)^{otimes 3}, and every edge joins comparable labels. The only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each removing P tensor F tensor Q of dimension h.
For nested U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U. The N first edges on X_a are the exceptions, each 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero.
The plan gives the signed total W m-2N, L=Ich, absolute changes W m-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 is derived from I=3v^2, c=100 and h=100, and L_c/N=101/539 is given. Both are below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 and s<Wm.
S1.3.3.7.4 gives P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a and 0 to F elsewhere, so M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m. S1.3.5 turns this into Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V), using the triangular factors as controlled shifts and one interchange per one of Pi. S1.3.7.1 counts exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, so F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). eta_b > 20*2^{-50} and log m<20 give s_b/W_b < m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in their roles: the bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source edges, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, one interchange per unit of rank, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only implicit element is m=h^3, which follows from the stated label space (Q^h)^{otimes 3}.
